cases.scenario: A documented one-use fixture coupon increases the test ledger twice on sequential redemption.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm the excess benefit from durable ledger changes, not response count.

cases.scenario: Two requests return success but resolve to the same redemption record and one credit.
cases.expected_decision: Treat as a valid retry if it meets the contract.

cases.scenario: Repeated use works, but no policy establishes a limit or forbidden stacking.
cases.expected_decision: Describe the missing rule; do not invent a financial loss or limit.
